policies.answer: Breakfast buffet is served 6:30–10:30 in Marina Restaurant. It's included in direct bookings; otherwise it's SAR 75 per adult and free for children under 6.
Valet parking is free for in-house guests.
We arrange airport transfers from King Fahd International (DMM) for SAR 220 each way in a sedan, or SAR 320 in a van. Book at least 24 hours ahead.
Flexible rates can be cancelled free of charge until 48 hours before arrival. After that, the first night is charged.
The rooftop pool and gym are open 6:00–23:00. The pool has family hours and ladies-only hours. Ask us for this week's timetable.
Unfortunately we can't accommodate pets, except registered service animals.
Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is until 12:00. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability; late check-out until 16:00 costs 50% of the nightly rate.
